div.blockquote:
F1 — Hub Manager unreachable >2 hours
→ Ops Center calls pre-designated backup contact at sub-WH
→ If still unreachable: dispatch staff physically to sub-WH
→ Hub Manager authority temporarily assumed by Emergency Coordinator

div.blockquote:
F2 — Volunteer team overdue >2 hours
→ Hub Manager calls Team Leader, then individual volunteers
→ If no contact after 30 min: notify Civil Defense, report last known route
→ All other teams HOLD until situation resolved

div.blockquote:
F3 — Ward authority withdraws sub-WH access mid-operation
→ Hub Manager contacts Ops Center immediately
→ Emergency Coordinator escalates to district authority (higher than ward)
→ Hub Manager activates BACKUP sub-WH (pre-identified Phase 0)
